initial_state: Core0 and Core1 hold the target line in S; a distinct Core0 cold miss has started an L2 refill before Core1 stores to the shared target line
memory_model: same deterministic 64-byte writable-line model in both runs
comparison: Conservative serialization versus clean invalidation allowed during an active L2 fill; both use the ready/valid handshake fix
limits: Single fixed-seed targeted contention experiment; it isolates the selected resource overlap but is not a broad workload distribution.
RTL simulation cycle counts do not measure physical frequency, area, SRAM implementation, or DRAM bandwidth.
Owner-data Snoop and L2 refill writes remain serialized because both require the shared L2 line-data write port.
